road_to_rhum.display_name: EMIRA IV — Road to the Route du Rhum
road_to_rhum.status: Departed Collingwood 8-9 Aug 2026 (earlier than the published mid-August plan); transatlantic delivery to France, then Route du Rhum prep. Race starts 1 Nov 2026, Saint-Malo — Shawyer's first solo transatlantic on a foiling IMOCA.
key_open_questions: Where the boat is right now (position decays weekly)
Refit scope and shore base in France

vg2028_qualification.status: Published outline (imoca.org / vendeeglobe.org): one Grade 2 solo race finished on the race boat within 2x the winner's time, top-37 Globe Series cut, 40-boat cap; registration opened 16 Feb 2026.
key_open_questions: What the campaign has banked vs what remains
Which designated races Shawyer will enter

fleet_2028_cycle.status: New-generation builds entering the water through 2026-27 (Simon's Groupe Dubreuil II launched Aug 2026); the cycle races in the shadow of Charlie Dalin's death (11 Jun 2026).
key_open_questions: Which campaigns build new vs optimise proven hulls

canadian_lineage.status: Birch (won the first Route du Rhum, 1978, by 98 seconds) — Roufs (lost in the 1996-97 Vendée) — Hatfield — Shawyer. No Canadian has completed the Vendée Globe.
key_open_questions: Canadian media and public attention as the campaign grows
